about: SmartAssist's voice commands, on Android (VoiceAssistant.kt) and iPhone (src/services/voiceAssistant.ts). Each command has patterns: the words people say, with {placeholders} for the parts that change. Patterns are tried from top to bottom and the first one that fits wins, so put longer patterns before shorter ones. Write patterns in lower case, without punctuation. Each command's examples must match one of its patterns (src/__tests__/voiceCommands.test.ts checks this). Replies are what SmartAssist says; keep their {placeholders}. iphoneApps are the apps "open …" can open on iPhone, where apps can only be opened by their link (Android opens any app by name). Rebuild the app (npx expo run:android or npx expo run:ios) after a change.

patterns: send a message to {contact} on {messenger} saying {message}
examples: Send a message to Mum saying I'm on my way
send a WhatsApp message to Tunde saying call me later
tell Aunty Ngozi that the meeting is at five
text David saying I am home

patterns: how much battery do i have
examples: How much battery do I have?

replies.notHeard: I didn't hear anything. Tap Speak and try again.
replies.notUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Try saying: open WhatsApp.
replies.needMicrophone: SmartAssist needs the microphone to hear you. Tap Speak again and allow it.
replies.needContacts: SmartAssist needs your contacts to find {contact}.
replies.needPhone: SmartAssist needs permission to make calls.
replies.needSms: SmartAssist needs permission to send text messages.
replies.noApp: I couldn't find an app called {app}.
replies.noContact: I couldn't find {contact} in your contacts.
replies.confirmMessage: Send: {message}. To {contact}, on {messenger}? Say yes or no.
replies.pressSend: I've typed your message to {contact}. Press Send to send it.
replies.unsupportedMessenger: I can send messages on WhatsApp or by text. I can't send on {messenger} yet.
replies.help: You can say: open WhatsApp. Send a message to Mum saying I'm on my way. Call Mum. What time is it. Read the screen.
replies.needSpeech: SmartAssist needs the microphone and speech recognition to hear you. Turn them on in Settings, then try again.
replies.noSpeech: I can't listen right now. Check your internet connection and try again, or type your command.
replies.iphoneCantOpen: On iPhone, I can't open {app} myself. Say: Hey Siri, open {app}.
replies.iphoneReadScreen: On iPhone, Apple reads the screen for you. Swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers, or say: Hey Siri, speak screen.
replies.iphoneTapSend: Opening WhatsApp with your message to {contact}. Tap the Send arrow to send it.
replies.iphoneSmsReady: Your text to {contact} is ready. Tap the blue arrow to send it.
replies.iphoneCalling: Calling {contact}. If your iPhone asks, tap Call.
replies.noBattery: I can't check the battery right now.
